rules-penalties.title: What's an offence?

config.intro: Allowed, or an offence under the Act?

cases.situation: A quick test transmission just outside the band edge, at under 1 W.
cases.why: Outside the amateur bands is prohibited at any power.

cases.situation: Giving a wrong location for a club event as a joke.
The maximum penalty for a false distress call is…
options: Up to $5000, up to a year in prison, or both
cases.answer: Up to $5000, up to a year in prison, or both
cases.why: Set out in the Radiocommunication Act.

cases.situation: Deliberately interfering with a contact, without lawful cause, carries…
options: Up to $5000, up to a year in prison, or both
cases.answer: Up to $5000, up to a year in prison, or both
cases.why: The same penalty as a false distress message.

rules-penalties.success: Stay in the bands, never send false information, and never interfere on purpose.
